findings.message: No HTTP security headers (Content-Security-Policy, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy) are configured in next.config.ts. This is a pre-existing condition accepted for the hackathon MVP prototype per PRD §NFR-006.
findings.evidence: next.config.ts contains only reactCompiler: true — no headers() configuration.
findings.suggested_action: Before any production deployment, add a headers() export to next.config.ts that sets at minimum: Content-Security-Policy (restrict script-src to 'self'), X-Frame-Options: DENY, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, and Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin. The property to preserve is that the application cannot be framed by untrusted origins and that MIME-sniffing attacks are mitigated.
